title: NormalizedPattern
description: Standardized database-ready schema for traditional and museum embroidery patterns in Lihuaji.

id.description: Unique primary key identifier across all pattern archives.

originalTitle.description: Original archival title in museum catalogue or source repository.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary title or English subtitle.

region.description: Cultural geographic region (e.g. 江南, 中原, 巴蜀, 齐鲁, 岭南, 西北, 荆楚, 燕赵, 闽台, 中国传统).

collection.description: Difficulty & sampling tier: 'basic' for beginner sampling, 'archive' for complex reference.

styleFamily.description: Specific motif family (e.g. 如意/灵芝云, 流云/波浪云, 团云/朵云, 连续/结构云, 云气纹).

tags.description: Subject and motif classifications (e.g. 花草藤蔓, 鸟兽鱼虫, 人物故事, 几何与团花, 边饰与织锦).

period.description: Historical period, dynasty or creation date (e.g. 1300s, 清代, 明代, 西汉).

technique.description: Medium, textile materials and craft techniques.

image.description: Relative path to high-resolution display WebP asset.

thumbnail.description: Relative path to thumbnail WebP asset.

imageSha256.description: SHA-256 integrity hash of high-resolution image.

thumbnailSha256.description: SHA-256 integrity hash of thumbnail image.

sourcePlatform.description: Originating museum platform or collection repository (e.g. The Met, 克利夫兰艺术博物馆, 梨花季馆藏).

sourceUrl.description: Canonical web URL to original artwork record.

sourceApiUrl.description: REST API URL for museum open access object.

license.description: Rights status (e.g. CC0, Public Domain, 开放许可).

museumObjectId.description: Numeric or alphanumeric ID within originating museum database.

rightsVerifiedAt.description: Date of copyright and public domain status verification (ISO format).

description.description: Detailed curator narrative and pattern description.

sortWeight.description: Display priority weight in search and catalogue listings.

searchTerms.description: Indexed search terms combining keywords, eras and aliases for full-text queries.
